div.head: Af 60
div.ab: Gif se litla finger bið ofaslægen, ðæm scel to bote IX scll'; his nægles, gif se bið ofaslægen, I scll'.
Gif se lytla finger bið ófaslegen, ðam sceal to bote VIIII scill., ⁊ an scill. his nægles, gif se sie ófaslegen.
Si minimus digitus amputetur, IX solid. emendetur; unguis eius I sol.
Gif se lytla finger bið ófaslegen, ðam sceal to bote VIIII scill, ⁊ an scill his nægles, gif se sie ófaslegen.
If the little finger is struck off, for that 9 shillings shall be compensation, and one shilling for its nail, if it is struck off.
If the little finger is struck off, 9 shillings must be paid as compensation for it, and one shilling [must be paid as compensation for] the nail of the same, if it is struck off.
Wenn der kleine Finger abgeschlagen ist, dafür gebührt 9 Schill. zur Busse; und ein Schilling [die] seines Nagels, wenn der abgeschlagen ist.
If the little finger is struck off, 9 shillings are due for it as compensation; and one shilling [that] for its nail, if that is struck off.
